mostWorthwhile.text: Building the epidermal barrier was most worthwhile: the planned picture and prose connect lipids and outer cells to reduced water loss and ongoing renewal.

leastWorthwhile.text: Assembling and fitting the sweat gland felt repetitive: the duct and pore are clear, but the results do not explain sweating's function.

surprise.text: The completed skin's explanation clarified that vessels nourish its deeper layer and sensory endings connect it to the nervous system.

arbitrary.text: The gland's placement made physical sense, but its purpose remained unclear in the supplied prose. The menu supplied compatibility rather than requiring me to discover it.

continue.text: I would probably not continue personally: the barrier and renewal were useful, but several fittings were predictable and offered little explanation.
